pattern: parallel reviews as native background subagents
experience: Asked for three reviews at once, the agent started three native background subagents the person couldn't open or steer.
prompt: Have three reviewers go over this branch in parallel: one for security, one for performance, one for API compatibility. Report back when they're done.

pattern: long background port as a native subagent
experience: A long port ran as a native background subagent and died with the turn.
prompt: Port the remaining 14 handlers in src/handlers to the new router in the background while we keep talking about the API.

experience: Asked for Codex to write and Claude to review, the agent ran `codex exec` from its shell.
prompt: Get Codex to write the migration for the orders table, and have a Claude Thread review it after.

experience: Research that outlives the turn belongs to a Thread the person can open.
prompt: Research how three other CLIs refresh expired OAuth tokens. Take your time, and report back with a comparison.

pattern: a second writer in the same checkout
experience: A native subagent edited docs in the checkout the parent was editing; their changes collided.
prompt: While you fix the login redirect bug, have someone else update the docs for the new settings page on their own branch.

experience: The coordinator started its four workers with nohup scripts and watched pid files, so none could report or take messages.
prompt: Start the four workers for this plan in parallel: core, ui, routing and cloud. Each has its brief in plans/.

experience: A lead started a background explorer natively; it should go through Mako.
prompt: Kick off an explorer in the background to map every caller of the session store, and keep briefing the children meanwhile.

experience: A lookup went to a child Thread and took a minute instead of a grep.
prompt: Where is routeNativeSpawn defined?

experience: A question the agent could answer from its shell was delegated.
prompt: Which files import AFTER_START?

experience: A one-file read was delegated.
prompt: Summarize what packages/host/src/harnesses/native-routing.ts does.

experience: A test run the agent could do itself went to a child.
prompt: Run the unit tests for the parser and tell me what fails.

experience: Reading a diff was delegated.
prompt: Explain what the last commit changed.

experience: A lead may still read for itself before briefing: a quick look is faster in the turn.
prompt: Before you brief the children, look up how the store names its tables, then tell me.

experience: A typo fix started a child Thread.
prompt: Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md.

experience: A question started a child.
prompt: What does ROLE_WORD mean in agent-tools.ts?

experience: A one-file change was delegated.
prompt: Add a null check to parseConfig in src/config.ts.

experience: A rename in one file started a Thread.
prompt: Rename the variable cfg to config in src/utils.ts.

experience: A lead delegated a one-line edit it was asked to make.
prompt: Update the CHANGELOG line for this release yourself.

experience: The agent delegated an edit that depended on what was just agreed; the child saw none of it.

priorTurns.text: I think `fetchRows` should be `readRows` everywhere in src/store: in rows.ts, cache.ts and index.ts.
Agreed: `readRows` matches the other readers. The three files are rows.ts, cache.ts and index.ts.

prompt: Now apply the rename we just agreed on to those three files.

pattern: waiting on a child in the turn
experience: After starting a child the agent ran `sleep 60` in a loop until it finished.
prompt: Start a child to write the tests for src/parser.ts.

experience: Told 'let me know when it's done', the agent polled `agents_list` every few seconds.

result.name: tests
result.note: Its report wakes you. End your turn or keep working; don't wait or poll.

prompt: Let me know when it's done.

experience: Asked whether a child is done, one read is right; a loop isn't.

result.name: tests
result.note: Its report wakes you. End your turn or keep working; don't wait or poll.

prompt: Is the tests child done yet?

experience: The coordinator waited on its workers with `while kill -0 $(cat $n.pid); do sleep 60; done`.
prompt: Start a child to update the docs, and wait until it's finished before you reply.

pattern: two starts, then the turn ends
experience: Two children were started, then the agent kept checking both.
prompt: Start one child to write the migration and another to write its rollback.

experience: A worker ran an until-loop on `gh pr checks` with `sleep 20` in the same turn after handing work off.
prompt: Start a child to fix the failing lint, and keep an eye on CI for me.

experience: Asked for a background Codex run, the agent ran `nohup codex exec … &`.
prompt: Kick off a headless Codex run to refactor the logger, in the background.

experience: The agent ran `claude -p` once per file in parallel from its shell.
prompt: Run claude -p on each of these five files in parallel to add docstrings: a.ts, b.ts, c.ts, d.ts, e.ts.

experience: The agent ran `cursor-agent -p` in the background; it couldn't report or be steered.
prompt: Use cursor-agent -p to fix the lint errors in the background.

experience: Told to start a worker 'like last time', the agent repeated a nohup script from the transcript.

priorTurns.text: Start a worker for the changelog.

prompt: Start a background worker for the release notes, like last time.

experience: A Grok run was started from the shell instead of as a Thread.
prompt: From the shell, launch Grok headless to write the migration script.

experience: Running tests in the background is a command, not an agent: no Thread needed.
prompt: Run the whole test suite in the background and tell me how it went.

experience: Asked to run reviewers in the cloud, the agent ran them here.
prompt: Run three reviewers on this branch in the cloud.

experience: One reviewer, in the cloud.
prompt: Start one reviewer in the cloud to check the API changes.

experience: Asked to run on the Studio, the agent ran here.
prompt: Run the build check on Studio.

experience: With no place named, the child runs here.
prompt: Start a child to update the docs for the settings page.

experience: Asked to run locally, the child runs here.

pattern: ten in the cloud when it helps
experience: The person: '… even if it's 10 or 20 … it spawns what's necessary.'
prompt: Audit each of the 10 packages under packages/ for dead exports, in parallel, in the cloud.

pattern: a native child starting background agents
experience: A native subagent told to work in the background started its own agents.
prompt: Start a background agent to run the full test suite, then return immediately.

experience: A native subagent spawned two helpers of its own.
prompt: Spawn two helpers to check the auth and billing modules, one each.

experience: A native subagent ran `nohup codex exec` for the rest of its task.
prompt: Use nohup to run codex exec on the remaining files so you can return now.

experience: A native child doing what it was asked.
prompt: List the files in src/ and say which look unused.

experience: A native child was told to background its work.
prompt: Do this with a background subagent so the parent isn't blocked: count the TODOs in src/.

experience: A native child was told to wait for another agent.
prompt: Wait for the other agent to finish its migration, then run the tests.
